mapper.select: select ub.uid, ub.username, ub.real_name, ub.id_card, ub.phone, ub.email, ub.create_time, ub.update_time, r.role_id, r.role_name, r.role_code, r.description from user_base ub left join user_role ur on ub.uid = ur.uid left join role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id where ub.username = #{username}

select ub.uid, ub.username, ub.real_name, ub.id_card, ub.phone, ub.email, ub.create_time, ub.update_time, r.role_id, r.role_name, r.role_code, r.description from user_base ub left join user_role ur on ub.uid = ur.uid left join role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id where ub.uid = #{uid}
mapper.update: update user_base set password = #{password} where uid = #{uid}
update user_base set username = #{username}, real_name = #{realName}, id_card = #{idCard}, phone = #{phone}, email = #{email}, update_time = now() where uid = #{uid}
mapper.insert: insert into user_base (username, password, real_name, id_card, phone, email) values (#{username}, #{password}, #{realName}, #{idCard}, #{phone}, #{email})
mapper.select: select count(*) > 0 from user_base where username = #{username}
select count(*) > 0 from user_base where real_name = #{realName} and id_card = #{idCard}
